decision: Preserve/refactor the old HRAIN/Titan uplink into one nonblocking Outbox. ADV sends canonical JSON publication requests to the Registry Gateway; the gateway writes to GitHub; HRain reads those GitHub-backed JSON sources as a visualization/context plane.
reason: Current HRain/GitHub Pages is a read-only/static consumer, not a secure ingest server.
canonical_flow: ADV -> Outbox -> Registry Gateway -> GitHub JSON -> HRain read-only graph
